from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxInfo(BaseModel):
    """Tax payable information from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    taxes_payable: float | None = Field(description="The amount of taxes payable (应交税费) as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    unit: str = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency unit")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Optional verbatim text containing the tax figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_info_list: list[CompanyTaxInfo]
